## Review checklist

- [ ] This PR does not add client code, relay code, message transport, mailbox behavior, cryptography, or deployment configuration.
- [ ] Each material claim has an evidence ID and a public, fixed, or reproducible source.
- [ ] Public stable APIs, internal implementation details, local experiments, and inference are separated.
- [ ] Evidence uses repository-relative paths and contains no server address, credential, token, private key, cookie, or local `.env`.
- [ ] This PR does not claim E2EE, arbitrary existing-TUI attachment, peer-message injection, or `429` observation without approved evidence.
- [ ] An independent reviewer is identified for any gate decision.
